name: AI Builder
description: Select a structure, describe a design, and AI builds it in the editor.

provider.name: AI Provider
provider.description:
<cy>Anthropic (Claude)</c> uses api.anthropic.com.
<cy>OpenAI-compatible</c> works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini's OpenAI endpoint, or a local Ollama / LM Studio server (set the Base URL below).

api-key.name: API Key
api-key.description: Your API key for the selected provider. Stored locally in your Geode save folder. Leave empty for local servers like Ollama.

base-url.name: Base URL (OpenAI-compatible only)
base-url.description: Endpoint root, without /chat/completions. OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1 - OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 - Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1

max-objects.name: Max Objects Per Build
max-objects.description: Hard cap on how many objects one generation can place.

max-tokens.name: Max Output Tokens
max-tokens.description: Upper limit on the AI's response length. Bigger designs need more tokens (roughly 12 tokens per object).

apply-colors.name: Apply Color Channels
apply-colors.description: Let the AI set the colors of color channels it uses (e.g. for pixel art). Turn off to keep your level's existing colors.

strict-ids.name: Only Known Object IDs
strict-ids.description: Only place object IDs from the built-in palette or from your selected structure. Turning this off lets the AI use any ID, which can produce wrong objects.
